title: Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2017 to 31 March 2018
what_it_is: Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2017 to 31 March 2018

sections.label: Estimates amendments and guillotine times
sections.summary: The passage states totals for each Head of Expenditure in the Main and Development Estimates, 545 amendments submitted, and guillotine times under Standing Order 92(7)(a).

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: For convenience, I shall take the totals for each Head of Expenditure in the Main and Development Estimates as they appear in the last columns of the schedules of estimated expenditure under the Main and Development Estimates Outlays for FY 2017 on pages 6 and 7 respectively of the Command Paper.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: A total of 545 amendments to the Estimates of Expenditure have been submitted this year.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: The guillotine times to the discussion of the Heads of Expenditure under Standing Order 92(7)(a) have taken into consideration the earlier commencement time of a sitting, the reduction of Question Time and Parliament's resolution to extend sitting times of the Committee of Supply for each allotted day.
